// Signal-event outcomes, not filled-trade performance. Each signal is tracked separately.
var int totalSignals = 0
var int successCount = 0
var int failureCount = 0
var int ambiguousCount = 0
var int expiredCount = 0
var signalBars = array.new_int()
var signalPrices = array.new_float()
var signalLows = array.new_float()

// Process previous signals before registering the current close-confirmed signal.
if array.size(signalBars) > 0
    for i = array.size(signalBars) - 1 to 0
        age = bar_index - array.get(signalBars, i)
        if age >= 1 and age <= 7
            success = high >= array.get(signalPrices, i) * 1.02
            failure = low < array.get(signalLows, i)
            finished = success or failure or age == 7
            if success and failure
                ambiguousCount += 1
            else if success
                successCount += 1
            else if failure
                failureCount += 1
            else if age == 7
                expiredCount += 1
            if finished
                array.remove(signalBars, i)
                array.remove(signalPrices, i)
                array.remove(signalLows, i)

if buyCondition
    strategy.entry("Buy", strategy.long)
    totalSignals += 1
    array.push(signalBars, bar_index)
    array.push(signalPrices, close)
    array.push(signalLows, low)

if sellCondition
